steps.action: Open isolator S3-A at substation bus
steps.safety_check: Confirm no back-feed from DG set. Verify phase rotation.

steps.action: Transfer Vadgaon load via tie switch S4-B
steps.safety_check: Check thermal rating of S4-B before energising. Max load 120A.

steps.action: Close feeder tie S5-T to restore Pirangut and Bavdhan
steps.safety_check: Ensure fault on S3 is cleared before closing S5-T. Check earth continuity.
